passages.title: A Family Trip to Tongyeong: Day One
text: I got up at six in the morning.
It was the first day of my family trip to Tongyeong.
We arrived at Jungang Market at 1 p.m.
There we had Chungmu gimbap for lunch.
There was only rice inside the roll!
Dad said, “Try the roll with radish and squid. Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea.”
It was a bit spicy but tasty.
In the afternoon, we went to Yi Sun-sin Park.
There was a huge statue of Admiral Yi.
I imagined the great battle right off the coast of Tongyeong.
Then we enjoyed taking a walk along the coast.
I could feel Admiral Yi’s love for the country.
koreanText: 아빠는 “롤을 무와 오징어랑 함께 먹어 봐. 오래전에 어부들은 바다에 나가서 충무김밥을 먹었어.”라고 말씀하셨다.
나는 통영의 해안 바로 앞에서 있었던 위대한 전투를 상상했다.
그다음에 우리는 해안을 따라 산책하는 것을 즐겼다.
나는 이순신 장군의 나라에 대한 사랑을 느낄 수 있었다.
